name: Flytech Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Flytech Technology Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells endpoint sales systems, information service systems, hardware and software integration services, and related peripherals in Taiwan, Asia, the Americas, Europe, and Africa. It offers all-in-one point-of-sales (POS), panel PC, handheld POS, mobile POS, self-service kiosk, and box PC. The company also provides remote management unified endpoint management. It serves retail, hospitality, medical, and industrial automation sectors. Flytech Technology Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
